high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Lance Ying (@LanceYing42) dated 21/07/25. The tweet discusses the concept of human adaptability and how it relates to cognitive science research. It suggests that humans' ability to adapt involves world model induction at different levels of abstraction. The tweet includes two main sections of text: Main Text: Humans need to adapt to new rules, norms, language, agents, and objectives. Decades of research in cognitive science suggest that human-like adaptation necessitates world model induction at different levels of abstraction.
